archive.scope: Current selections from five licensed collections; not the entire Archive.

nfb.scope: Free public film entries at build time; the official embedded player enforces current access and region.

pbskids.scope: Current PBS KIDS homepage editorial selection, only publisher-enabled viral embeds; not the entire PBS KIDS library.
pbskids.embedPermission: Official viral player config allow_embed=true AND is_playable=true, with generated Embed UI confirmed on example3103689019.

newson.selection: Complete advertised live directory plus fresh-resolving latest-newscast cards only where a current supported guest offer was confirmed. No expiring clip or playback URL is persisted.

xumo.source: Xumo current public website regional live directory
xumo.advertising: Fresh publisher SSAI offers and full ad query parameters retained; no client VMAP or tracking URL is supplied by the current live offer.

cw.source: The CW current public web live directory
cw.countrySource: The CW US web-service lineup; no per-channel international rights or country override is asserted.
cw.advertising: Fresh publisher fast_params and all offered SSAI stream queries retained. Preplay, client preroll, subscriber and protected modes are excluded.

yupptv.source: YuppTV current public free guest guide
yupptv.countryRule: Explicit source-mapped channel IDs only; viewer country and language are never used as channel country.
yupptv.advertising: Fresh publisher preUrl/preRollUrl via Google IMA; unsupported required schedules are refused.
yupptv.publicRestProtocol: Authorized public page/content and page/stream endpoints; no encrypted web-envelope configuration is required.
yupptv.playbackScope: Directory availability is checked again on play. Region, access, clear-HLS availability and advertising can change.

worldtv.name: World TV — official broadcasters
worldtv.scope: Curated selection of two official broadcaster live players; not a complete country or IPTV-org lineup.
worldtv.countryBasis: Broadcaster headquarters or national identity from the linked primary source; not viewer IP, language or programme location.
worldtv.refresh: Maintainer-only metadata refresh. Al Jazeera’s stored live embed ID may change; no real-time freshness is claimed.
